ablation.claim_boundary: No single-factor ablation differs significantly from full CRMT after Holm correction for any held-out objective; do not claim independent component superiority.

next_primary_task: Claim-evidence reconciliation followed by manuscript-ready tables/figures and Results/Discussion drafting from frozen evidence only.

opsd_external_ood.claim_boundary: External OOD evidence supports objective-specific paired comparisons only. It does not support universal robustness, hardware equivalence, or universal optimizer superiority.
statistical_findings: Friedman omnibus significant only for flip_per_day (p=0.000010).
cap_violation_pct_total Friedman p=0.064195: not significant at alpha=0.05.
lfp_cycle_loss_pct Friedman p=0.448101: not significant at alpha=0.05.
ramp95_kw_per_min Friedman p=0.189929: not significant at alpha=0.05.
CRMT ramp95 is lower than SOBOL; Holm-adjusted p=0.005850; median(SOBOL-CRMT)=0.0002588203.
For flip_per_day, SOBOL, NSGAII and MODE are lower than CRMT; Holm-adjusted p=0.030627, 0.000187 and 0.000140 respectively.

overall_claim_boundary: The frozen evidence supports strong TRAIN optimizer-quality results and objective-specific held-out/OOD comparisons, but not universal operational superiority, universal OOD robustness, hardware/real-time equivalence, battery-lifetime guarantees, or global optimality.

sensitivity.claim_boundary: Sensitivity is objective-dependent: RAMP_HALF and RAMP_QUARTER show no change; ETA_LOW_090, ETA_IDEAL_100, SOC_CONSERVATIVE_15_95 and TEMPORAL_FLOOR produce significant changes across objectives, with direction interpreted per minimized metric.
